assertions: real OpenTelemetry SDK spans are exported through actual OTLP/HTTP rather than a substitute tracing implementation
independent API, worker and provider runtimes share the checkout trace through persisted producer context and actual SQL delivery
the durable parent identifies a captured real producer span and provider server spans inherit an actual client span
changing trace headers preserves a command's saved response and appends exactly one checkout-started event
optional durable metadata has an additive SQL reader expansion and a producer flag kept off during old-reader rollout
trace and log values exclude credentials, request bodies, raw URLs, SQL statements/parameters and tenant/resource identities
varying forty product identifiers does not grow HTTP metric cardinality beyond its authored template
private metrics endpoints reject absent or tenant API credentials and accept the independent reader key
bounded exporter failure is observable without changing a successful business response
a single SQL snapshot distinguishes PostgreSQL source lag from equal-version Inventory value disagreement
actual Prometheus scrapes the private endpoint, fires separate lag and integrity alerts and resolves both after fixture repair
native PromQL queries observe availability and merged-histogram latency records with a stable non-status denominator
audit ownership and configured target failure prevent unstarted or missing audit evidence from being labeled healthy
two real migration jobs block behind the transaction advisory lock, a third waiting caller cancels, and both jobs finish with one expansion record
the existing real historical/current application drill supplies compatible traffic, reader expansion, guarded contraction and rollback evidence
static release executables supply their actual VCS/compiler/platform/dependency metadata and reject replaced or unchecksummed dependencies
official pinned CycloneDX schemas validate the SBOM and its module names/versions/sums match the actual binary
artifact checksums are distinct from Go module directory hashes and do not alone claim publisher authentication
the manual candidate workflow gates attestation on a successful same-repository CI run for the exact SHA
Helm rejects mutable image references, shared database secret names and durable trace emission before reader readiness
deployment references provide bounded migration jobs, readiness/liveness separation and zero-unavailable API rolling settings
the AWS reference contains only credential containers and artifact/log boundaries with no applied infrastructure or secret values
the actual observation profile exposes a provisioned Grafana dashboard and a Jaeger trace across API, worker and provider
the original 88-package baseline retains its complete semantic, transport, scale, security and operational audit scope
